title: Present Perfect Continuous
intro: Present perfect continuous: have/has been + kata kerja -ing. Untuk kegiatan yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung. Pakai for untuk lama waktu (for two hours) dan since untuk titik mulai (since 2020).

exercises.question: I ___ English for two years.
exercises.explanation: Rumusnya have been + kata kerja -ing. 'I' memakai have.

exercises.question: They have been waiting ___ three hours.
exercises.explanation: Pakai for untuk lama waktu (three hours). Since dipakai untuk titik mulai, seperti since Monday.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the present perfect continuous
exercises.explanation: 'He' memakai has been, lalu kata kerja -ing: has been reading.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the present perfect continuous
exercises.explanation: 'We' memakai have been + waiting. Since menandakan titik mulai.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.answer: She has been cooking for two hours
exercises.explanation: Subjek + has been + kata kerja -ing + for + lama waktu.

exercises.prompt: Match each phrase to for or since
exercises.explanation: For dipakai untuk lama waktu (two hours, a long time). Since dipakai untuk titik mulai (Monday, 2020).

exercises.question: Pick the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: Rumusnya have been, bukan have being. 'They' memakai have, bukan has.

exercises.task: Write one sentence about something you have been doing for a long time.
exercises.modelAnswer: I have been learning English for three years.
exercises.explanation: Gunakan have/has been + kata kerja -ing, misalnya 'I have been learning English for three years.'
